review_text: Ordered a matcha latte, iced Americano, cookies, and a sandwich — everything was super yummy. The matcha was smooth and not too sweet, the Americano was really good, and the sandwich was noicee and filling. We stayed for a bit to get some work done, and it’s actually a nice spot for that. The Wi-Fi was fast, and the music was a bit loud but still a fun vibe. The place feels cozy and makes you want to stay longer. It’s a small space, but the aircon is really good, perfect for escaping the heat of the pelepens. Definitely a nice spot to hang out or get some work done while enjoying good food and drinks.
